tests.description: Timed check on Violence, Terrorism and War

questions.question: Explain two religious teachings about violence and terrorism.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Christianity teaches non-violence — Jesus said "Turn the other cheek" (Matthew 5:39) and "All who draw the sword will die by the sword" (Matthew 26:52). While most Christians accept war as a last resort (Just War theory), terrorism that targets civilians is always condemned. 2) Islam forbids killing innocent people — Surah 5:32 states "Whoever kills a soul... it is as if he had slain all of man
